Seit 1945 sind wir ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen und das leben wir - Entwicklungsperspektiven, Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege.

Wir wachsen kontinuierlich und suchen Kollegen/innen, die unser Team tatkräftig unterstützen.

Als Servicetechniker (gn) im Außendienst bist du selbstständig in deiner Region und weltweit unterwegs.

Aufgaben

  • Mechanischer Aufbau unserer Anlagen bei nationalen und internationalen Kunden vor Ort - 100% Reisebereitschaft mit einer durchschnittlichen Einsätzen von zwei bis drei Wochen
  • Selbstständige Durchführung von Inbetriebnahmen
  • Unterstützung beim Stellen von Stahlbauten und Einbringen von Komponenten
  • Durchführung von Service- und Wartungseinsätzen für unsere weltweiten
    Bestandskunden
  • Deine Arbeit ist abwechslungsreich, da wir zu einem Großteil individuelle Kundenanforderungen erfüllen

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z.B. Mechatronik, Elektronik)
  • Berufseinsteiger oder mit Berufserfahrung im entsprechenden Bereich
  • Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch
  • Französischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert
  • Selbständige Arbeitsweise, Teamplayer und Reisebereitschaft
  • Einen Führerschein der Klasse B

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub
  • Mobiles Arbeiten (Hybrid) und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Betriebliche Zusatzversicherung „Remmert Gesundheitskonto 600“ für jeden Mitarbeiter (gn): Jährliches persönliches Gesundheitsbudget in Höhe von 600 EUR Nettowert für z. B. ärztliche Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, Arznei-, Heil- und Hilfsmittel wie Hörgeräte und Sehhilfen (inkl. Sehschärfenkorrekturen), medizinische Massagen und Maßnahmen, Zahnersatz und Zahnprophylaxe, Naturheilverfahren u. v. m.
  • Bezuschussung von Zahnersatz von bis zu 70 Prozent
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement (u. A. Gesundheitschecks, Vorsorgemaßnahmen während der Arbeitszeit, Laufgruppen, Teilnahme an Firmenläufen)
  • Sonderboni wie Gewinnbeteiligung, Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter, E-Bike Leasing
  • Kaffee, Obst und Gemüse zum freien Verzehr – auch während der Arbeitszeiten
  • Entwicklungsperspektiven in Form von jährlichen Gehalts- und Jahresgesprächen (360 Grad)
  • Förderung von Weiterbildungen mit vorhandenem Weiterbildungskatalog für alle Berufsgruppen
  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Sommerausflug, Wandertage sowie Weihnachtsfeiern für alle Kollegen und deren Familien)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge durch ein Zuschussmodell mit attraktiven Arbeitgeberbeiträgen

Du bist eine langfristig orientierte Persönlichkeit und kannst Dir vorstellen zum Team Remmert zu gehören?

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>Bei der Brand Wavemaker fördern wir das Wachstum unserer Kunden, indem wir Entscheidungen und Erlebnisse der Verbraucher durch Medien, Inhalte und Technologie neu gestalten. Unser Name steht sowohl für unsere Mission als auch für unsere Methode: Wir setzen uns für mutige Marken und Menschen ein, die Herausforderungen lieben – um gemeinsam weiter und schneller voranzukommen.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das bieten wir dir:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance</strong>: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten &amp; Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first:&nbsp;</strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das bewegst du:</strong></h2> <p>Als <strong>(Senior) Data Manager (Mensch)</strong> bist du das schlagende Herz unserer datengestützten Entscheidungen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative Strategien für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln.</p> <p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Datenmanagement:</strong>&nbsp;Deine hohe Zahlen- und Daten-Affinität sowie deine Gründlichkeit und Strukturiertheit im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen kommen hier voll zum Einsatz.</li> <li><strong>Dashboard-Pflege:</strong>&nbsp;Die Datenbank für ein zentrales, PowerBI-basiertes SOA (Share of Advertising) Dashboard pflegst du und sorgst für die korrekte Aufbereitung und Einpflegung neuer Datensätze.</li> <li><strong>Datenharmonisierung:</strong>&nbsp;Von dir werden Datensätze und -strukturen harmonisiert und (re-)standardisiert, um sich weiterentwickelnden Analyse-Anforderungen gerecht zu werden.</li> <li><strong>Analytisches Denken:</strong>&nbsp;Eigenständig führst du Daten- und Trend-Analysen mittels des SOA Dashboards durch, identifizierst und fasst die Kern-Insights zusammen.</li> <li><strong>Projekt-Management:</strong>&nbsp;Du unterstützt bei übergreifenden Daten-Anfragen auch über das SOA Dashboard hinaus, beispielsweise durch das Briefing und die Koordinierung von Partner-Teams zur Beschaffung von Daten für MMMs (Marketing Mix Models).</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung &amp; Automatisierung:</strong>&nbsp;Prozesse und Prozess-Schritte analysierst und identifizierst du, um sie zu automatisieren, durch KI zu unterstützen oder anderweitig zu vereinfachen und implementierst anschließend die Lösungen.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <p><strong></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Analytisches Geschick:</strong>&nbsp;Mit deinem ausgeprägten analytischen Verständnis und deiner Begeisterung für Zahlen und Daten wandelst du komplexe Datensätze in klare Insights um.</li> <li><strong>Tool-Kompetenz:</strong>&nbsp;Der sichere Umgang mit Datenvisualisierungstools, insbesondere PowerBI, zeichnet dich aus und du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit Datenbanken gesammelt.</li> <li><strong>Projektmanagement:</strong>&nbsp;Deine Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement ermöglichen es dir, auch komplexe Datenanfragen souverän zu koordinieren und verschiedene Stakeholder zu steuern.</li> <li><strong>Innovationsgeist:</strong>&nbsp;„Haben wir schon immer so gemacht“ ist für dich ein No-Go; du bringst proaktiv Ideen zur Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung, auch mittels KI, ein.</li> <li><strong>Kommunikationsstärke:</strong>&nbsp;Deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich aufzubereiten, macht dich zu einem geschätzten Ansprechpartner im Team und für Partner.</li> <li><strong>Strukturierte Arbeitsweise:</strong>&nbsp;Eine hohe Genauigkeit und eine strukturierte Herangehensweise erlauben es dir, auch bei großen Datenmengen stets den Überblick zu behalten und für eine hohe Datenqualität zu sorgen.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #organisiert #lösungsorientiert #proaktiv</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln&nbsp;und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br>&nbsp;<br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. #LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

We are hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to help scale Yepoda's global performance engine across paid channels. In this hands-on role, you will own efficient customer acquisition (prospecting, conversion, and retargeting) and balance strategic thinking with execution.

Your Tasks

  • Plan, execute, and continuously optimise performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search (Google Ads) and Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) to hit revenue and ROAS targets

  • Act as the primary owner for platform account managers (Google and Meta reps), driving beta access, strategic support, and account audits

  • Actively manage and reallocate monthly performance budgets dynamically across channels to capture demand efficiently

  • Manage product feed architecture using tools like Channable to ensure clean product data mapping across Google Shopping, Meta Catalogs, and TikTok

  • Monitor daily account health, leverage GA4 to analyse user journeys, and partner with internal data and tech leads to maintain robust tracking and attribution integrity

  • Collaborate with the creative team to brief high-converting ad formats, especially UGC and video concepts for TikTok and Meta, and scale winning assets based on creative testing frameworks

Your Profile

  • 2 to 3 years of hands-on performance marketing experience in D2C ecommerce, beauty, lifestyle, or skincare experience is a major plus

  • Proven experience in Paid Search (Google Search, Shopping, PMax) alongside Paid Social (Meta Ads Manager and/or TikTok Ads Manager)

  • Comfortable translating raw metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversion rates) into actionable optimisation steps and strategic suggestions

  • A self-starter capable of taking immediate ownership of existing workflows and hitting the ground running in a fast-paced D2C environment

  • Nice to have: hands-on experience with feed management platforms such as Channable and web analytics tools (GA4, GTM)

  • Nice to have: experience with additional channels (Pinterest, Amazon, Affiliate networks) or familiarity with server-side tracking (CAPI) setups

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default

  • Employee Discounts: You'll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

title: Growth Manager (Berlin)
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. At Almedia, you’ll: Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast. Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity. Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people. Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need. Senior Growth Manager (Berlin) Salary Range: €55K – €75K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus At a Glance You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it. What You’ll Do 🎯 Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes. Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong. Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day. Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint. Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner. Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset. What your first 90 days look like Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on. Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement. Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book. Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step. What You’ll Bring 💡 You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it. You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions. You're bilingual in the best sense , equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day. Bonus points if you: Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2. We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Senior Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.


What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond. Salary and equity scale with each step.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities, experienced in developing and executing complex sales strategies, contract negotiation, and operational leadership. Architektur & Produkt: Du triffst technische Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit den Gründern. Du denkst Architektur, Produkt und Nutzererlebnis gemeinsam. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Wartbarkeit und langfristige Skalierbarkeit. Qualifikation Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript, Node.js und PostgreSQL. Du hast bereits Produkte von der Idee bis in den produktiven Betrieb gebracht. Du denkst in Nutzerproblemen statt in Tickets. Du hast Erfahrung mit APIs, Domain Modeling, Authentifizierung und skalierbaren Architekturen. Coding Agents gehören selbstverständlich zu deinem täglichen Workflow. Du verstehst, welche Standards, Dokumentation und Contracts KI benötigt, um zuverlässig Software zu entwickeln. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Produktentwicklung und Plattform-Engineering. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke. Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und denkst unternehmerisch. Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse und arbeitest gerne eng mit unseren Praxisteams zusammen. Berufserfahrung ist wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist dein Anspruch. Du wartest nicht auf Anforderungen. Wir entwickeln sie für unsere eigenen Praxen. Jede Verbesserung, die du entwickelst, wird unmittelbar im Alltag eingesetzt. Impact+: Die Menschen, die deine Software nutzen, sitzen nur wenige U-Bahn-Stationen entfernt. Feedback bekommst du oft noch am selben Tag. Engineering+: Entwickle Produkte. Entwickle die Architektur darunter. Nutze beides jeden Tag selbst. Learning+: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern eines Teams, das bereits mehrere Unternehmen erfolgreich aufgebaut hat. Scale+: Heute betreiben wir drei Praxen in Berlin. Unser Ziel sind über 100 Standorte und mehr als 1.000 Therapeuten.Du baust die technologische Grundlage für dieses Wachstum. Tech+ TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS/CDK, Contract-first APIs, Shared SDKs, Design System, Clean Architecture und AI-first Development. Das klingt nach dir? We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Sr. AV Operations Specialist, UK</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Please note:</strong> this role requires full-time onsite presence in London</em></p> <p><em><strong>Location: </strong>London, South Bank/Central London (County Hall)</em></p> <p><em><strong>Salary Range:</strong> £36,000-38,000/annually + eligibility for discretionary annual bonus</em></p> <p><strong><em>Start Date:&nbsp;</em></strong><em>As soon as possible (within 1-2 months)</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Convene Hospitality Group and etc.venues, a global industry leader in premium meeting, event, flexible office, and membership spaces is seeking a full-time Senior AV Operations Specialist to join our Operations team at one of our flagship etc.venues locations in Central London. The Senior AV Operations Specialist will exemplify a passion for Hospitality, Events, and AV Technology along with being a proponent of cultivating a positive and inclusive employee culture. In this role, the Senior AV Operations Specialist will partner with and report directly to the General Manager as well as the Technology Manager.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Senior AV Operations Specialist provides and supports all services used to deliver technology to our customers and associates including networking, desktop support, audio, video, HSIA, audio &amp; video conferencing, webcasting, and basic lighting for a variety of corporate meetings and events. The AV Operations Specialist works closely with customers and the AV Management Team to deliver an excellent meeting, conference, and working experience. The person in this role also works directly with the property and event teams to deliver excellent client experiences.</p> <ul> <li>Lead ad-hoc troubleshooting and assistance to customers of all technology competency levels.</li> <li>Troubleshoot AV equipment, including but not limited to audio, video, lighting, computer networking systems, and hardware.</li> <li>Evaluation and troubleshooting of personal computer hardware and software, peripheral devices, mobile devices, and network component problems.</li> <li>Lead pre-program coordination with property teams, and the AV Operations Manager, ensuring that all their technological needs are met and in place for their arrival.</li> <li>Provide genuine anticipatory customer service by establishing good working relationships with Convene team members, divisions, and vendors.</li> <li>Audit tech quotes to ensure review is completed ahead of events and attend PEO, Pre-Con, and pre-production meetings as needed.</li> <li>Supervise daily floor operations, manage set up and strike, lead room teams, oversee equipment, and support other ad hoc AV property functions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop and maintain positive relationships with clients and assist with any reasonable requests during programs.</li> <li>Interact with the Production team to ensure a thorough understanding of the client experience with Convene prior to the start of their meeting/event.</li> <li>Assist in any areas of daily operation.</li> <li>Participate in collaborative project efforts with both the technology team and other departments.</li> <li>Review and recommend updates to departmental SOPs on a quarterly basis.</li> <li>Maintain and uphold Convenes cultural standards</li> <li>Perform other duties as requested by management.</li> <li>Show initiative and drive to solve problems.</li> <li>Portray a polished, professional image according to Convene dress code standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Look For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma/GED required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred</li> <li>4-5 years of experience in supporting AV and IT equipment and computer software systems.</li> <li>Customer service or hospitality experience preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrate knowledge of audiovisual equipment including analog/digital audio mixers, wireless microphone systems, seamless video switchers, and projectors/displays.</li> <li>Possess a basic understanding of Crestron and other central control systems.</li> <li>Basic knowledge of data networking principles, architecture, and applications.</li> <li>Experience in the basic installation, configuration, operation and administration of operating systems, applications and hardware for Macs, PCs, LANs, and servers.</li> <li>Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google worksuite, and Apple iWorks suite of business applications.</li> <li>Flexible, long, and weekend hours are sometimes required.</li> <li>Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects up to 25 pounds without assistance.</li> <li>Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.</li> <li>Ability to stand, sit, or walk for an extended period.</li> <li>Ability to climb and work on a ladder for lengthy periods.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equipment &amp; Technical Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Audio</strong>: 4-48 channel analog/digital mixers, wireless microphone lavaliers and handhelds, push-to-talk microphone systems, audio recorders. Familiarity with Biamp Server/Forte systems is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Video</strong>: Switchers, projectors, LCD displays, LED Video Walls, Media Server familiarity a plus</li> <li><strong>Lighting</strong>: Knowledge of Lighting Maps, lighting concepts, and lighting best practices, familiarity with rigging.</li> <li><strong>IT</strong>: Wi-Fi troubleshooting, connecting hardline internet, Knowledge of DHCP/Static IP addressing, operating, other collaboration tools and equipment</li> <li><strong>Hybrid:</strong> Familiarity with virtual meeting and event platform functions as well as live streaming technologies including cameras, encoders, lighting, and transmission protocols i.e. RTMPs/HLS/SRT.</li> <li><strong>Control: </strong>Familiarity with Crestron control systems and associated hardware, familiarity with AVoIP fundamentals a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’re Here For You:</strong></p> <p>At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Health &amp; Wellness:</strong> Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Time Off &amp; Balance:</strong> 25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay.</li> <li><strong>Financial Benefits:</strong> Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.</li> <li><strong>Growth &amp; Recognition:</strong> Career development opportunities and programs to celebrate your achievements.</li> <li><strong>Community &amp; Impact:</strong> Volunteer, donate, and make a real impact through your work.</li> </ul> <p>At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you’re excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we’d love to have you on the team.</p> <p>Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.</p> <p>#LI-LC1</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Business Operations Manager - Product, Data Insights & Reporting
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>We are seeking a highly collaborative and strategic Business Operations Manager<strong>&nbsp;(Product Data Insights &amp; Reporting)</strong> to serve as the vital operational bridge between our technical data execution and cross-functional business decision-making. In this role, you will lead the effort to transform product and organizational data into actionable insights for our Product and Engineering organization, driving alignment and helping senior leadership make high-impact decisions.</p> <p>You are an exceptional relationship builder, translator, and team advocate. Rather than focusing on hands-on technical execution, your strength lies in your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, influence stakeholders across diverse teams, and translate complex data points into compelling narratives that drive business outcomes.</p> <p><strong>You impact</strong></p> <ol> <li>Establish deep, trusting partnerships with engineering and product stakeholders as well as cross-functional leadership, acting as the primary strategic bridge between analytical execution and business decision-making.</li> <li>Translate analytical projects into highly compelling narratives, framing our roadmap in a way that resonates with senior stakeholders and drives meaningful alignment.</li> <li>Navigate organizational dynamics and competing priorities with high political acumen, ensuring data-backed recommendations are successfully adopted and operationalized.</li> <li>Maintain stakeholder momentum and manage expectations gracefully during long delivery cycles, keeping partners excited and bought into the long-term analytics vision.</li> <li>Advocate passionately for the analytics function, leveraging high demand for insights to build compelling cases for expanded support.</li> <li>Lead, mentor, and protect a lean team of technical analysts, providing the necessary "air cover" for them to focus on deep execution while actively coaching them on communication and influencing skills.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Your Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong experience within the technology industry</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of product operations, business insights, program management, or a related role—ideally within a fast-paced SaaS, product, or engineering organization.</li> <li>A strong background of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, executive presence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among senior leadership.</li> <li>Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance) and successfully influencing decision-making without direct authority.</li> <li>Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical data into simple, actionable insights for senior leadership.</li> <li>Ability to manage a high volume of incoming requests, establish clear operational triage frameworks, and comfortably manage stakeholder expectations.</li> <li>A solid understanding of how product analytics and reporting structures operate (e.g., data flows, modeling, or visualization tools) to effectively translate technical needs, though hands-on coding/modeling is not required.</li> <li>Deep understanding of modern development methodologies (e.g., Agile, SAFe) and the product lifecycle in a SaaS context.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong> &nbsp;</p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not: &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. &nbsp;</li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. &nbsp;</p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.</p> <p>You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.</p> <p>The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the vertical roadmap. title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. raw.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. Every permanent team member gets equity, so when we grow, you do too. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership. Big tech impact, without the big tech ick. This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers by designing and delivering scalable integrations. It bridges the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE) to accelerate time-to-value within defined scope, timeline, and budget. About You Technical Expertise: You have strong hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, APIs, enterprise integration patterns, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang). Language & Communication: You possess proven ability to explain complex technical concepts effortlessly to both engineers and business stakeholders. AI Leverage: You fluently use AI coding assistants and automation tools to accelerate spec drafting, data analysis, and code development securely. Mindset & Approach: You are a self-directed, customer-first problem solver who context-switches easily, balances standard methodologies with edge-case judgment, and prioritises team success. Delivering Technical Solutions: Scoping, designing, building, testing, and handing off standard integration and automation projects end-to-end within defined timelines and budgets. Partnering Across GTM & Engineering: Collaborating with Account Executives during pre-sales, joining forces with CSMs and Onboarding Managers to accelerate deployment, and bridging customer feedback to Product, Design & Engineering to shape the roadmap. Building Scalable Tooling: Identifying recurring technical patterns to build shared scripts, templates, and automations that reduce delivery effort across all customer accounts. Managing Scope & Architecture: Advising customers on sustainable system architecture, managing package boundaries, and escalating custom requirements effectively. At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through: Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary, Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility, Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns; We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK . Even if you don't meet every requirement listed in the ad, please consider applying for this role. We prioritise inclusion and value individuals with potential over a checklist of qualifications. Don't rule yourself out, hit that apply button if this job resonates with you You can find out more about life at Mitti via Youtube , Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn . Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.


The Role

We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.


You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.


That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.


What You'll Do

  • Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

  • Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

  • Shape and lead 6-week Shape Up cycles for new features and provider integrations

  • Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows

  • Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete

  • Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own

  • Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets

  • Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it

What We're Looking For

  • Product experience at lead, staff or principal level. Strong senior candidates are in scope if the rest lines up

  • An entrepreneurial streak. You've founded something, worked at an early-stage startup, or spent time in engineering before moving into product

  • You've owned the vision and strategy for an area, not just executed against someone else's

  • Comfortable with fluid scope. You've picked up an unfamiliar domain before and become useful quickly

  • Genuine cross-business collaboration. You've worked with support, success and sales, not only with engineers and designers with the occasional customer call

  • You come from an environment with a high quality bar. It usually shows in the product itself

  • Clear, concise communication, spoken and written, focused on value and outcomes rather than process

  • Scale-up experience, roughly Series A to D. Seed-stage experience on top of that is a plus

  • Comfortable managing people, or ready to start

  • Domain experience. Fintech or Insurtech is the closest match to what you'll work on, then HR tech, benefits, employee expenses or travel. Anything sold to an employer that employees then use. The business model matters more than the industry label: if you've had to serve both an HR buyer and the employees using the product, that's the experience we care about


Not every box needs ticking. We'd rather see someone strong on several of these and light on others than someone who technically matches everything.

Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this every day.

Kota Benefits

  • Health Insurance via Kota

  • Workplace Pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (country dependent)

  • WFH stipend to support your home office needs

  • Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need

  • Annual company-wide offsite and dedicated team offsite

Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things simple and respectful of your time.

  • Screening call (30 mins) with our talent team: your background, what you're looking for, and the practicalities

  • Competency interview (60 mins) with one of our Product Leads, covering how you work, what you've owned and how you make product calls

  • Task session (60 mins) with our GM and one other, working through a real Insurances problem together

  • Call with founders (30 mins) with our CEO and CTO: our vision, and your thoughts on it

title: Senior Research Associate
description: ABOUT MORE IN COMMON LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) CONTRACT: Full-time SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 START DATE: As soon as possible More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign. Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others. More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition. Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism. Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments. Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling. ABOUT THIS ROLE More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. Research Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners Comms and External Engagement Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations Supervision Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia. The key elements we’re looking for are: Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data. A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart. DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants. Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation. DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59 . Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered. Please apply following the link below. Indicative Timeline (please note these dates remain subject to change) Initial conversation with a hiring manager: w/c 21 September Interviews: late September – early October We expect to make an offer to the successful candidate by mid October if not before. For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). In the covering letter, please write up to 300 words on something that surprises you about public opinion in the UK today, why it surprises, and how you’d like to investigate it further. You must include this in your application for it to be considered.

Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling. Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners. title: Finance & BizOps, Marketing
description: TL;DR: Be the strategic finance partner to the Marketing Org. You will own the financial architecture behind every marketing dollar. You’ll build the models, measurement systems, and operating rhythms that ensure every investment compounds into growth. This is an ownership seat with direct executive visibility, not a reporting function. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What We’re Looking For Growth marketing strategist: You treat marketing spend as a portfolio of investments, not a cost center. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. You have an informed opinion on how brand spend, paid acquisition, and organic loops interact, and you back it with data. Technical and data-driven : Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure. Service-first partner : You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams. High-slope learner : You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10. Experience : 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required. What You’ll Do Drive marketing efficiency & planning: Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline. Build and own channel-level unit economics: Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go. Connect marketing performance to company outcomes: Work across the organization to ensure marketing investment ties to measurable business results. Analyze market trends, competitive spend, and channel dynamics to inform forward-looking strategy and ensure capital is deployed where it compounds. Support experimentation, reporting, and forecasting: Partner with Marketing to size tests, set success metrics, and forecast impact on growth and unit economics. Create clear, repeatable reporting to track performance, targets, variance, and learnings that translate into action. Accelerate with AI: Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer. You're expected to continuously push what's possible, replacing manual processes with scalable infrastructure that moves at Lovable's speed. About your application Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.</p> <p>Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.</p> <p>This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Optimise Fraud Detection:</strong>&nbsp;Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.</li> <li><strong>Enhance Payment Performance:</strong>&nbsp;Lead data-driven initiatives to boost payment authorisation rates, optimise transaction routing, and reduce costs.</li> <li><strong>Drive Profitability within Finance:</strong>&nbsp;Lead automation and profitability initiatives across different areas of Finance.</li> <li><strong>Communicate Performance:</strong>&nbsp;Report on all aspects of fraud, payments and finance performance to stakeholders at all levels, including C-level management.</li> <li><strong>Drive System Improvements:</strong>&nbsp;Collaborate with Fraud, Payments, Finance and Engineering teams to scope and implement enhancements to detection systems and data pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Innovate &amp; Automate:</strong>&nbsp;Proactively identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities, drive profitability, increase payment success, and enhance team efficiency through automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficient with SQL &amp; Python</li> <li>Proficient in a data visualisation software (Tableau/Looker/PowerBI/e.t.c.)</li> <li>Experience using a variety of machine learning algorithms</li> <li>Able to communicate effectively; using data to tell a story and drive business change</li> <li>Experience within Google Cloud preferential</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer.
